meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把你的 cmem.ai 凭据写入插件 config.json，让 hook 能捕获并注入记忆。Cowork 容器是临时的，配对要长期生效需重新打包成 .plugin 给你重装。
howto.when: 当你要求设置 claude-mem、连接 cmem，或提供 cmem.ai Connect 的 sync token、user id、SyncHub URL 时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置 claude-mem，用我 cmem.ai Connect 里的三项值
连一下 cmem，我的 sync token 待会儿给你
say.note: token 只写进文件，不会在对话里回显

say.text: 查一下 cmem hook 的状态
say.note: 返回遮蔽后的输出，MISSING 说明没写进去

howto.what_en: Claude writes your cmem.ai credentials into the plugin's config.json so hooks can capture and inject memory. Cowork containers are ephemeral: a pair lasts only this session unless the plugin is repackaged as .plugin for reinstall.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up claude-mem, connect cmem, or provide cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL).

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem with my cmem.ai Connect values
say_en.note: Credentials go into the plugin config.json

say_en.text: Pair cmem with my sync token
say_en.note: Token is only written to files, never echoed
Reports masked output; MISSING means the write failed
